tokens.usage: Raised panels: the counter panel, the result card.

tokens.usage: Panel borders, upcoming-day bars, dividers.

tokens.usage: Secondary button borders, upcoming set outlines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on ground and surface; done-set fills. 16:1 on ground.

tokens.usage: Body copy under headlines on ground. 11:1 on ground.
